const L = window.squaringLab, cv = document.getElementById('view'); const d0 = L.cam.dist; cv.dispatchEvent(new WheelEvent('wheel', { deltaY: 100, bubbles: true, cancelable: true, clientX: 300, clientY: 300 })); await new Promise(r => requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(r))); const d1 = L.cam.dist; await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 600)); const d2 = L.cam.dist; if (Math.abs(Math.abs(Math.log(d2 / d0)) - Math.log(1.12)) > 0.01) throw new Error('one wheel notch should change the distance by 12%: ' + d0 + ' -> ' + d2); if (!((d1 - d0) * (d2 - d1) > 0)) throw new Error('the zoom jumped instead of easing: ' + [d0, d1, d2]); L.cam.dist = d0; L.touch(); return 'wheel zoom eased ' + d0 + ' -> ' + d1.toFixed(3) + ' -> ' + d2.toFixed(3);

document.getElementById('ap-classic').click(); const L = window.squaringLab; L.S.n = 8; L.S.iter = 10; L.syncControls(); L.cam.target = [0,0,0]; L.cam.dist = 4.2; L.refresh(false); let busy = '', bar = false; for (let i = 0; i < 600 && !L.idle(); i++) { await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 16)); const b = document.getElementById('busy'), d = document.getElementById('drawProgress'); if (b && !b.hidden) busy = b.textContent; if (d && !d.hidden) bar = true; } if (!busy) throw new Error('no busy label while the new approach was being prepared'); if (!bar) throw new Error('the progress bar never showed while drawing'); return 'classic n=8; busy label seen: ' + busy + '; progress bar seen';
document.getElementById('ap-lathe').click(); const L = window.squaringLab; L.S.n = 2; L.S.param.lathe.spin = 3; L.syncControls(); L.refresh(false); return JSON.stringify(L.S.param.lathe);

document.getElementById('ap-mercator').click(); document.getElementById('mode-j').click(); const L = window.squaringLab; L.S.colour.mode = 2; L.S.colour.pal = 1; L.syncControls(); L.cam.pitch = 1.5; L.cam.yaw = -Math.PI / 2; L.cam.dist = 4.4; L.touch(); return 'julia, escape count, ember';
document.getElementById('mode-k').click(); return 'kleinian';

const $ = id => document.getElementById(id); document.querySelectorAll('details.sec').forEach(d => { d.open = true; }); const name = document.querySelector('#rules .rule .name').textContent; if (name !== 'Sphere inversions') throw new Error('the first approach should be Sphere inversions, it is ' + name); if ($('par-mercator-planes').max !== '8') throw new Error('the planes dial should go to 8'); for (const id of ['par-mercator-liftPlay', 'par-mercator-turnPlay', 'par-bulb-latPlay', 'par-bulb-lonPlay', 'par-classic-thetaPlay', 'par-classic-phiPlay', 'col-shiftPlay']) if (!$(id)) throw new Error('no play button ' + id); const foot = document.querySelector('footer.why').textContent; for (const t of ['Inversions added together can', 'The number of planes has nothing to do with the power', 'the solid pulses from its poles']) if (!foot.includes(t)) throw new Error('the closing text lacks: ' + t); if (/cannot be built from inversions/.test(document.body.textContent)) throw new Error('the old claim about inversions is still on the page'); if (!$('powStep') || $('iterStep')) throw new Error('step toggles: the power dial needs one, the iterations dial must not have one'); return document.querySelectorAll('.dial').length + ' dials, ' + document.querySelectorAll('select').length + ' selects, ' + document.querySelectorAll('.dial-reset').length + ' reset buttons';

const L = window.squaringLab, $ = id => document.getElementById(id); $('mode-m').click(); document.querySelector('#colDials .dial-reset').click(); L.S.q.aa = 2; L.syncControls(); $('flat').click(); if (!L.S.flat) throw new Error('the 2D view checkbox did not set S.flat'); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 300)); if ($('stage').dataset.cam !== 'flat') throw new Error('the stage did not switch to 2D input'); if (!$('camMode').hidden) throw new Error('the camera switch should hide in the 2D view'); return '2D view on, slice height ' + L.S.cut + ', picture height ' + L.S.v2.h.toFixed(2);

const L = window.squaringLab, $ = id => document.getElementById(id); $('flat').click(); if (L.S.flat) throw new Error('2D view did not switch off'); if (!$('m-mosaicCell').closest('.dial').hidden) throw new Error('the cell dial should be hidden until the mosaic is on'); $('m-mosaic').click(); if (!L.S.mosaic) throw new Error('the mosaic checkbox did not set S.mosaic'); if ($('m-mosaicCell').closest('.dial').hidden) throw new Error('the cell dial did not appear'); return 'mosaic on, cell ' + L.S.mosaicCell;
const L = window.squaringLab, $ = id => document.getElementById(id); $('flat').click(); return 'mosaic in the 2D view';

const L = window.squaringLab, $ = id => document.getElementById(id); const type = (id, v) => { const e = $(id); e.value = v; e.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'Enter', bubbles: true })); }; $('flat').click(); $('m-mosaic').click(); if (L.S.mosaic || L.S.flat) throw new Error('mosaic or 2D view still on'); type('powNum', '−2'); if (L.S.n !== -2) throw new Error('typing a negative power gave n = ' + L.S.n); if ($('pow').min !== '-8' || $('pow').max !== '10') throw new Error('the power slider is not -8 to 10'); return 'n = ' + L.S.n + ', formula: ' + $('f-mercator').textContent.slice(0, 60);

const L = window.squaringLab, $ = id => document.getElementById(id); const type = (id, v) => { const e = $(id); e.value = v; e.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'Enter', bubbles: true })); }; document.querySelector('#eqReset .dial-reset').click(); if (L.S.n !== 2 || L.S.iter !== 14) throw new Error('the Equation reset did not restore n and the iterations'); if (!$('par-mercator-turn').closest('.dial').hidden) throw new Error('the turn dial should be hidden with two planes'); type('par-mercator-planesNum', '1'); if ($('par-mercator-turn').closest('.dial').hidden) throw new Error('the turn dial did not appear with one plane'); type('par-mercator-turnNum', '40'); type('par-mercator-liftNum', '0.3'); const p = L.S.param.mercator; if (p.planes !== 1 || p.turn !== 40 || p.lift !== 0.3) throw new Error('approach parameters not set: ' + JSON.stringify(p)); if (!$('par-mercator-turnPlay')) throw new Error('the turn dial has no play button'); return JSON.stringify(p);

const L = window.squaringLab, $ = id => document.getElementById(id); const pick = (id, text) => { const e = $(id), o = [...e.options].find(x => x.text.startsWith(text)); if (!o) throw new Error('no option ' + text + ' in ' + id); e.value = o.value; e.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); }; document.querySelector('#approachReset .dial-reset').click(); const p = L.S.param.mercator; if (p.planes !== 2 || p.turn !== 0 || p.lift !== 0) throw new Error('the Approach reset left ' + JSON.stringify(p)); pick('col-trap', 'Cross'); pick('col-by', 'How near it came, as a glow'); pick('col-pal', 'Electric'); const c = L.S.colour; if (c.trap !== 1 || c.by !== 4) throw new Error('trap choice not set: ' + JSON.stringify(c)); return 'trap ' + c.trap + ', by ' + c.by + ', palette ' + c.pal;

const L = window.squaringLab, $ = id => document.getElementById(id); $('qUltra').click(); const q = L.S.q; if (q.de !== 0 || q.res !== 0.5 || q.aa !== 1 || q.shadow || q.ao || q.normals !== 'smooth') throw new Error('Ultra fast did not apply: ' + JSON.stringify(q)); if ($('qde').selectedIndex !== 2 || $('qShadow').checked) throw new Error('the quality controls do not show the preset'); return 'ultra fast: ' + JSON.stringify(q);

const L = window.squaringLab, $ = id => document.getElementById(id); $('mode-k').click(); if ($('kleinPanel').hidden || !$('juliaPanel').hidden || !$('secApproach').hidden) throw new Error('wrong panels for Kleinian mode'); const e = $('kleinPreset'), o = [...e.options].find(x => x.text.startsWith('1/3 cusp')); e.value = o.value; e.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); if (Math.abs(L.S.k.mx - 0.581203) > 1e-9 || L.S.k.three !== true) throw new Error('the Kleinian preset did not apply: ' + JSON.stringify(L.S.k)); if ($('kmxNum').value !== '0.581203') throw new Error('the Kleinian dials do not show the preset'); if (!$('kleinNote').textContent.startsWith('Turned out')) throw new Error('the preset note is missing'); return e.options.length + ' Kleinian presets; chosen: ' + o.text;

const L = window.squaringLab, $ = id => document.getElementById(id); $('mode-j').click(); $('qFast').click(); const items = [...document.querySelectorAll('#juliaList .plist-item')]; const b = items.find(x => x.textContent === 'Douady rabbit'); if (!b) throw new Error('no Douady rabbit in the list'); b.click(); const c = L.S.c; if (Math.abs(c[0] + 0.122561) > 1e-9 || Math.abs(c[1] - 0.744862) > 1e-9) throw new Error('the Julia preset did not set c: ' + c); if (L.S.param.mercator.planes !== 1 || L.S.iter < 24) throw new Error('planes or iterations not applied'); if ($('cyNum').value !== '0.744862') throw new Error('the c dials do not show the preset'); if (!b.parentNode.classList.contains('is-on')) throw new Error('the chosen entry is not marked'); $('juliaName').value = 'Smoke test point'; $('juliaSave').click(); const saved = L.juliaSaved(); if (!saved.length || saved[saved.length - 1].name !== 'Smoke test point') throw new Error('Save this point did not add to the list'); const n = saved.length; document.querySelector('#juliaList .plist-del:last-of-type').click(); const dels = document.querySelectorAll('#juliaList .plist-del').length; if (L.juliaSaved().length !== n - 1) throw new Error('Delete did not remove the saved point'); if ($('juliaSaveNote').hidden) throw new Error('no note that the point is kept for this visit only'); if (![...document.querySelectorAll('#juliaList .plist-item')].some(x => x.textContent === 'No storage point')) throw new Error('the saved point is not in the list'); document.querySelector('#juliaList .plist-del').click(); if (L.juliaSaved().length) throw new Error('delete failed when storage is blocked'); delete window.localStorage; return items.length + ' Julia points; saving also works with storage blocked; rabbit applied; saved and deleted one; ' + dels + ' saved left';

const L = window.squaringLab, $ = id => document.getElementById(id); $('camFly').click(); if (!L.S.view.fly || $('stage').dataset.cam === 'arc') await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 300)); if (!L.S.view.fly || $('stage').dataset.cam !== 'fly') throw new Error('the Fly button did not switch the camera'); if (!$('viewFly').checked) throw new Error('the View section checkbox did not follow'); const a = L.basis().pos.slice(), cv = $('view'); cv.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { code: 'KeyW', key: 'w', bubbles: true })); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 700)); window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keyup', { code: 'KeyW', key: 'w', bubbles: true })); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 400)); const b = L.basis().pos, moved = Math.hypot(b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1], b[2] - a[2]); if (!(moved > 0.05)) throw new Error('holding W did not move the fly camera: ' + moved); return 'fly camera moved ' + moved.toFixed(3) + ' at speed ' + L.S.view.speed;

const L = window.squaringLab, $ = id => document.getElementById(id); const type = (id, v) => { const e = $(id); e.value = v; e.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); e.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'Enter', bubbles: true })); }; const viewReset = document.querySelector('#viewReset .dial-reset'); viewReset.click(); if (L.S.view.fly || L.S.view.bound !== 8 || L.S.view.fov !== 0.32) throw new Error('the View reset left ' + JSON.stringify(L.S.view)); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 300)); if ($('stage').dataset.cam !== 'arc' || $('viewFly').checked) throw new Error('the camera did not go back to arcball'); type('camFar', '200'); if (L.S.view.zmax !== 200) throw new Error('typing the farthest zoom limit on the stage slider gave ' + L.S.view.zmax); type('viewBoundNum', '500'); if (L.S.view.bound !== 500) throw new Error('the drawing radius should reach 500, got ' + L.S.view.bound); type('viewBoundNum', '900'); if (L.S.view.bound !== 500) throw new Error('the drawing radius should stop at 500'); viewReset.click(); if (L.S.view.zmax !== 60 || L.S.view.bound !== 8) throw new Error('the View reset left the limits at ' + JSON.stringify(L.S.view)); document.querySelector('#qReset .dial-reset').click(); const q = L.S.q; if (q.de !== 3 || q.res !== 1 || q.aa !== 12 || !q.shadow || !q.ao || q.normals !== 'sharp' || q.steps !== 260) throw new Error('the Quality reset left ' + JSON.stringify(q)); if ($('qde').selectedIndex !== 0 || !$('qShadow').checked) throw new Error('the quality controls do not show the reset values'); document.querySelector('#juliaReset .dial-reset').click(); if (L.S.c.join() !== '-1,0,0') throw new Error('the Julia reset left c = ' + L.S.c); L.resetCam(); L.S.q.aa = 2; L.syncControls(); L.touch(); return document.querySelectorAll('.dial-reset').length + ' reset buttons; view (with zoom limits and drawing radius), quality and Julia resets restore their defaults';

const L = window.squaringLab, $ = id => document.getElementById(id); const secs = () => [...document.querySelectorAll('#sections > details.sec')].filter(d => !d.hidden); const b = $('collapseAll'); b.click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 200)); if (secs().some(d => d.open)) throw new Error('Collapse all left a section open'); if (b.textContent !== 'Expand all') throw new Error('the button should now read Expand all, it reads ' + b.textContent); return secs().length + ' sections collapsed: ' + secs().map(d => d.querySelector('summary').textContent).join(', ');

const $ = id => document.getElementById(id); const secs = () => [...document.querySelectorAll('#sections > details.sec')].filter(d => !d.hidden); const b = $('collapseAll'); b.click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 200)); if (secs().some(d => !d.open)) throw new Error('Expand all left a section closed'); if (b.textContent !== 'Collapse all') throw new Error('the button should read Collapse all again'); return 'expanded again';
